evidence: OS LINUX noted in header comments
no EXEC CICS/SQL, no COMP-3, consistent with GnuCOBOL on Linux
COPY count 32, CALL count 90 typical of ORCA subsystem

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - specifically co-payment amount calculation (負担金算定) for various insurance types including elderly care, national health insurance, workers compensation, etc.
purpose.summary: ORCS01 is a subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system that calculates patient co-payment amounts (負担金) for medical insurance claims. It handles multiple insurance types (national health, elderly, workers compensation, self-pay) and applies complex rules for co-payment ratios, upper limits, and regional public expense subsidies. The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2000-2008 covering numerous prefectural and national insurance regulation changes.

notable_features: Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, displayed as latin-1 mojibake)
90 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprogram architecture
683 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
No COMP-3 usage (unusual for financial calculations - likely uses DISPLAY numeric)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Long revision history with 100+ named revisions from 2000-2008
Handles multiple Japanese insurance types and regional public expense rules
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text appearing as mojibake. Source is truncated to first 16000 chars; the full file is ~1.47MB with 29408 lines. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system for Linux.
